name: Why is water standing in my sink or tub?

mainEntity.name: Why is water standing in my sink or tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standing water in your sink or tub is typically caused by a clog in the drainpipe. Common culprits include hair, soap scum, grease, food particles, or mineral buildup. These materials accumulate over time, restricting water flow and eventually leading to a complete blockage. It's also possible that the issue is further down the main drain line if multiple fixtures are affected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standing water is usually due to a clog in the drainpipe from hair, soap scum, grease, or other debris.
